classes.label: Domain Entity
classes.comment: Stable, real-world thing being indexed (company, product, person, model, etc.). Owns stable identifiers and canonical text; mutable counters live on observations.

classes.label: Entity Observation
classes.comment: A time-bound measurement or fact extracted from one source record about a DomainEntity. Carries mutable counters, metrics, and a rawRef pointer back to the source.

classes.label: Source Document
classes.comment: The outer container of sourced information (article, report, dataset, API response). Owns title, URL, publication timestamp, and source system metadata.

classes.label: Source Record
classes.comment: A single record extracted from a SourceDocument (one row, one item, one result). Owns result rank, record hash, and the local source path within the document.

classes.label: Institution
classes.comment: Typed node representing an organization, company, lab, or publisher mentioned in relation to an entity. Replaces opaque string arrays with a relation.

classes.label: Topic
classes.comment: Typed node representing a subject area, research theme, or categorical tag associated with an entity.

classes.label: Strategic Tag
classes.comment: Typed node representing a curated strategic label (e.g. 'emerging', 'risk', 'opportunity') applied to an entity for downstream reasoning.

objectProperties.label: observes entity
objectProperties.comment: Links an observation to the stable DomainEntity it describes.

objectProperties.label: observation from record
objectProperties.comment: Provenance link from an observation to the exact SourceRecord it was extracted from.

objectProperties.label: record from document
objectProperties.comment: Links a SourceRecord to its parent SourceDocument.

objectProperties.label: mentions institution
objectProperties.comment: Relates an entity to a typed Institution node, replacing opaque institution string arrays.

objectProperties.label: has topic
objectProperties.comment: Relates an entity to a typed Topic node, replacing opaque topic string arrays.

objectProperties.label: has strategic tag
objectProperties.comment: Relates an entity to a typed StrategicTag node, replacing opaque tag string arrays.

datatypeProperties.label: source identifier
datatypeProperties.comment: Stable identifier of the domain entity within its source system.

datatypeProperties.label: source title
datatypeProperties.comment: Human-readable source title used to represent the domain entity; unknown if absent.

datatypeProperties.label: source URL
datatypeProperties.comment: Canonical public URL of the domain entity; unknown if absent.

datatypeProperties.label: published at
datatypeProperties.comment: Normalized publication timestamp of the domain entity in ISO 8601 form.

datatypeProperties.label: raw reference
datatypeProperties.comment: Workspace-independent raw response file reference, relative to the Scope V2 result directory.

datatypeProperties.label: result rank
datatypeProperties.comment: One-based ordinal position of this observation within the filtered source result.

datatypeProperties.label: source system
datatypeProperties.comment: Identifier of the external system or pipeline that produced the document.

datatypeProperties.label: source path
datatypeProperties.comment: Raw response file path relative to the Scope V2 result directory.

datatypeProperties.label: record JSON pointer
datatypeProperties.comment: Exact RFC 6901-style JSON Pointer locating the source record inside the raw response file.

datatypeProperties.label: record hash
datatypeProperties.comment: Content hash of the raw record payload for deduplication and change detection.

approval.rationale: The public source identity fields belong to DomainEntity, mutable counters belong to EntityObservation, and raw-file provenance is split between SourceDocument and SourceRecord. sourcePath/rawRef remain workspace-independent file references while recordJsonPointer provides exact record-level location. Concrete source entity and observation classes are linked to the two base classes during composition.
